# Support for ClearView or Convergence

If you are an existing customer of ClearView or Convergence with support related questions, please refer to the information below.

**Have an existing support account?**

Log in to the support system to view your support request history and submit new support requests. You may also email your support request to clientcare@harmonyhit.com.

[Visit Customer Support Portal](https://hhit.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/69)

**New user and don’t have a support account?**

Not a problem. You may send an email to [clientcare@harmonyhit.com](mailto:clientcare@harmonyhit.com) – no existing support account required.

If you prefer to create a support account our support portal also allows self-service account creation. With an account you will gain the ability to view your entire support history and easily add attachments to open requests.  Just click the “Sign up” link on the login page.

**Looking for documentation?**

Access our portal for product documentation and release notes.  If you do not have a login currently, please send a request via a method listed above to support and a documentation account will be created for you.  If you have a login to our JIRA system currently, the same login will work to access documentation. If your current login does not allow documentation access, please submit a support request for your login to be granted access to documentation.

[Visit Documentation Portal](https://hhit.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/TDH/overview)

**Government user and need support?**

Log in to our support portal to create or view support queues.

[Visit Government Support Portal](https://hhit.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/73)

**Who should I contact if I have questions?**

For new products or sales inquiries, please contact us here or reach out to your Account Manager.

If you are an existing ClearView or Convergence customer with support related questions, please refer to the support information above, or email us at [support@harmonyhit.com](mailto:support@harmonyhit.com).
